  items. All non-food items qualify. Dry and wet food items don't qualify but orders with fewer than
  3 qualifying items still receive a 25% shipping discount.
* How do I change my EZ-Ship recurring order?
  
  Simply go online and add or delete any item that you want to change from your EZ Ship package.
  It's simple!

  Orders ship within 1–2 business days (excluding Saturday and Sunday). Once on their way, you'll
  receive a tracking confirmation by email. You can also monitor your order status and access
  tracking at any time under Orders in your account menu.

# Purpose

We are a global community of scientists, veterinarians, producers and many others united by our
singular purpose: to nurture our world and humankind by advancing care for animals. Together, we are
helping to shape a healthier future—for animals, for people, for our planet, for all of us. This
commitment defines us as colleagues and as a business.

[Learn More][113]
[Close-up of an automated lab pipetting instrument dispensing into tubes, with a Zoetis researcher
in a lab coat blurred in the background holding a clipboard - Zoetis]

# Innovation

Powered by rigorous science and transformative thinking, we're shaping the next frontier of animal
health. From first-to-market therapies to AI-powered diagnostic platforms, our innovations span the
Continuum of Care—predicting, preventing, detecting, and treating disease to meet unmet needs today
while preparing our customers for the challenges of tomorrow.

[Learn More][114]

# Innovation

Powered by rigorous science and transformative thinking, we're shaping the next frontier of animal
health. From first-to-market therapies to AI-powered diagnostic platforms, our innovations span the
Continuum of Care—predicting, preventing, detecting, and treating disease to meet unmet needs today
while preparing our customers for the challenges of tomorrow.

[Learn More][114]
[A fluffy dog stands on its hind legs greeting a seated colleague while other colleagues watch and
smile near a large window - Zoetis]

# Culture

Our colleagues around the globe are connected through an unwavering commitment to those we serve and
to one another. We've built an award-winning workplace where people feel valued, included,
supported, and proud—living our Core Beliefs every day as we advance animal health and well-being in
over 100 countries.

[Learn More][115]
[Underwater scene with a school of Pangasius fish swimming through clear blue water - Zoetis]

# Sustainability

We are committed to championing a healthier, more sustainable future. One that benefits our
communities, animals and the planet we share. Through our Driven to Care approach, we strive to be
the most sustainable animal health company and create a healthier world for all.

[Learn More][116]
[Group of Zoetis scientists in white lab coats and safety glasses chatting and smiling in a bright
laboratory corridor - Zoetis]

INNOVATORS FOR ANIMALS

# Real Stories, Revolutionary Science

Discover the stories behind our science. Innovators for Animals showcases the veterinarians,
livestock producers, researchers, and purpose-driven colleagues creating life-changing results for
animals and the people who care for them.

[Learn More][117]
Toggle autoplay
[Family in meadow with cattle - Zoetis]

### Welcome to Zoetis

As the world’s leading animal health company, Zoetis is driven by a singular purpose: to nurture our
world and humankind by advancing care for animals. 

With a legacy of nearly 75 years, Zoetis continues to pioneer ways to predict, prevent, detect, and
treat animal illness, supporting veterinarians, livestock producers, and pet owners in over 100
countries.  

We integrate deep scientific expertise, data-driven R&D, advanced manufacturing, and commercial
excellence to deliver meaningful innovation across medicines, vaccines, diagnostics,
biopharmaceuticals, and digital solutions.

# Innovation

Powered by rigorous science and transformative thinking, we're shaping the next frontier of animal
health. From first-to-market therapies to AI-powered diagnostic platforms, our innovations span the
Continuum of Care—predicting, preventing, detecting, and treating disease to meet unmet needs today

[A fluffy dog stands on its hind legs greeting a seated colleague while other colleagues watch and

# Culture

Our colleagues around the globe are connected through an unwavering commitment to those we serve and
to one another. We've built an award-winning workplace where people feel valued, included,
supported, and proud—living our Core Beliefs every day as we advance animal health and well-being in
over 100 countries.

[Learn More][115]
[Underwater scene with a school of Pangasius fish swimming through clear blue water - Zoetis]

# Sustainability

We are committed to championing a healthier, more sustainable future. One that benefits our
communities, animals and the planet we share. Through our Driven to Care approach, we strive to be
the most sustainable animal health company and create a healthier world for all.

[Learn More][116]
[Group of Zoetis scientists in white lab coats and safety glasses chatting and smiling in a bright
laboratory corridor - Zoetis]

INNOVATORS FOR ANIMALS

# Real Stories, Revolutionary Science

Discover the stories behind our science. Innovators for Animals showcases the veterinarians,
livestock producers, researchers, and purpose-driven colleagues creating life-changing results for
animals and the people who care for them.

[Learn More][117]

### Welcome to Zoetis

As the world’s leading animal health company, Zoetis is driven by a singular purpose: to nurture our
world and humankind by advancing care for animals. 

With a legacy of nearly 75 years, Zoetis continues to pioneer ways to predict, prevent, detect, and
treat animal illness, supporting veterinarians, livestock producers, and pet owners in over 100
countries.  

We integrate deep scientific expertise, data-driven R&D, advanced manufacturing, and commercial
excellence to deliver meaningful innovation across medicines, vaccines, diagnostics,
biopharmaceuticals, and digital solutions.

### About Any Pest Control Services

Established in 1999, we pride ourselves on providing a professional, thorough and prompt service. At
Any Pest Control Services, we can deal with all types of pests. We aim to provide excellent quality
services at an affordable price. We cover a range of facilities, including schools, restaurants,
hotels, offices, building sites, student accommodation, pubs, shops, warehouses and food production
facilities.
We offer excellent bird proofing and pest control solutions tailored to your exact needs and
building type. If you need a quotation, [get in touch with us][48] today.
[pest3]

### A discreet pest control solution

Discretion is of the utmost importance. Whether it is a commercial or domestic customer, all our
vehicles are unmarked so that your pest control problem is not made public.
We will visit your property and carry out a range of pest control treatments to help you get rid of
unwanted pests including rats, ants, bed bugs, squirrels and pigeons.

and trustworthy coverage so our pets can live happier, healthier, longer lives.

## Pet plans that work

Explore flexible coverage, customizable to you

Most Popular Plan

### Complete Coverage^{SM}

Coverage that offers things you’d want and expect for your pet when they’re hurt or sick and covers
exam fees and costs of diagnostics and treatment for accidents, illnesses, hereditary conditions,
and behavioral issues.

[See Pricing][79]

#### Accidents

Injuries including broken paws and swallowed objects

#### Hereditary Conditions

Inherited conditions such as kidney or heart disease

#### Illnesses

Includes minor illnesses to serious diseases, like cancer

#### [Behavioral Issues][80]

Issues like destructive scratching or excessive vocalization

#### [Dental Disease][81]

Covers dental diseases like gingivitis, and tooth extractions for dental accidents.

#### Alternative Therapies

Treatments for covered conditions like acupuncture, chiropractic care, and hydrotherapy

## Low Cost. Big Heart.

Emancipet is a nonprofit organization on a mission to make veterinary care affordable and accessible
to everyone.

[ Find a Clinic ][80]
[ Donate ][81]

### This Holiday Season, Join Us in Making Veterinary Care Affordable & Accessible

[ Donate Today ][82]

### About Us

Pets are family. They bring joy and unconditional love to our lives, and they deserve a lifetime of
health and well-being. Emancipet is a nonprofit organization that operates low-cost veterinary
clinics in neighborhoods across the country to ensure all pet families in need have access to
affordable veterinary care for their pets.

[ Learn More ][83]

### Find Your Clinic

Looking for high-quality care for your pet? Emancipet provides healthy pet services and more at
low-cost vet clinics in Houston, Austin, Killeen, and Central Texas as well as Philadelphia,
Pennsylvania.
[ Find Care Near You ][84]

### Services

Our experienced team of licensed veterinarians and trained technicians help your pets stay healthy,
happy, and at home with their favorite people. Each clinic offers a unique set of services based on
the needs of their local communities.

Through our affordable spay/neuter, vaccine and preventive services, we serve the Indianapolis
community by keeping
animals out of shelters and with their families. As a non-profit, FACE services
and programs are supported by the generosity of our donors.

Dogs – $210
Cats – $135

DAPP – Canine Combo – $20
FVRCP – Feline Combo – $20
Leptospirosis – Canine – $20

Revolution + –
$28 / monthly
$70 / 3 months
$140 / 6 months

Drontal – $11

$32 / monthly

$160 / 6 months

Feline Leukemia – $25

##### Over-The-Counter Medicines

Effitix – $15
Effipro – $11.90

##### Tests

FeLV/FIV Combo Test – $30
Heartworm Test – $30

##### Extras

Spay/Neuter deposit – $65 cats & dogs both
Vaccine appointment deposit – $20
Brief exam fee – $20
Microchip – $25
Nail trims – $28
Surgery declined exam fee – $40

##### Surgery Times

# Search Tips
* When searching in a cemetery, use the **`?`** or **`*`** wildcards in name fields. **`?`**
  replaces one letter. **`*`** represents zero to many letters. *E.g. Sorens?n or Wil**
* Search for an exact birth/death year or select a range, before or after.
* Select "More search options" to:
  * Search for a memorial or contributor by **ID**.
  * Include the name of a **spouse, parent, child or sibling** in your search.
  * Use partial name search or similar name spellings to catch alternate spellings or broaden your
    search.
  * Narrow your results to famous, Non-Cemetery Burials, memorials with or without grave photos and
    more.
